newsitem.title: USA: Conrail halts rail line cluster sales.
newsitem.headline: Conrail halts rail line cluster sales.

text.p: Conrail Inc said Thursday it decided to retain ownership and operation of freight service in six clusters of lines it previously planned to sell to short line or regional railroads.

Conrail said it originally announced its intention to sell the clusters in January 1996, but changed its plans after agreement was reached on breaking Conrail up and dividing it between CSX Corp and Norfolk Southern Corp.

The line clusters are in the Battle Creek-Jackson- Ypsilanti, Mich., area, the Boston area, the Buffalo, N.Y., to Keating, Pa., corridor, the Danville, Ill., to Terre Haute, Ind., corridor, the Montreal to Syracuse, N.Y., corridor, and the Niles-North Warren-Cortland-Brier Hill area in Ohio.
